mentions.name: Untether Comms
mentions.description: Garmin watch app for replying to Android notifications (e.g. WhatsApp/SMS) with voice, using the paired phone's microphone for on-board dictation and transcription. Part of an offline, privacy-first suite that turns a Garmin sportswatch into a smartwatch without cloud services; currently in beta.
mentions.problem: Watch built-in keyboards are tough to use for replying to messages.
mentions.audience: Garmin smartwatch users who want to reduce phone screentime while keeping essential functionality
mentions.author: msyea
